name: Epic Systems
feed: GET https://careers.epic.com/jobs/ (Next.js RSC flight data in self.__next_f.push: allOpenJobs[] ids + avaturePositions{id: {...}} map)
page_total_how: Playwright render of https://careers.epic.com/jobs/ (2026-10-20T00:16Z) showed 'Showing 41 positions' with 41 unique FolderDetail links; allOpenJobs = 41 = the cached-api search with an empty query (same ids, same order).
robots: ALLOW careers.epic.com (Allow: /); BLOCK epic.avature.net/Careers/* (Disallow: /), so job links may be emailed but never fetched
notes: Avature (epic.avature.net) is the system of record but its Careers portal is robots-disallowed. The careers.epic.com list page server-renders every open job's id and title in its RSC payload. The payload has no location field (Epic hires on its Verona, WI campus).
